title: Horam
summary: Raleigh names Horam in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Horam, king of Gezar, who came to the relief of Lachis and perished. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VI, §. VIII, sig. 215a
